summary: The walk list on a canvasser's phone shows each person's name, age and party and whether they have already voted.
realLife: Canvassers in several accounts used a voter app that showed each address's residents, past visits and recorded answers, and out-of-date lists included people who had moved.
sources: Ronald Claiborne Substack, Confessions of a campaign canvasser, undated: https://ronaldclaiborne.substack.com/p/confessions-of-a-campaign-canvasser
Yahoo News, Canvassers descend on Phoenix for one last push: what it is like on both sides of the door, undated: https://www.yahoo.com/news/canvassers-descend-phoenix-one-last-200537117.html
Daily Kos, Tales from the Field: Hitting the Doors in NOVA, 2021-10-31: https://www.dailykos.com/stories/2021/10/31/2061272/-Tales-from-the-Field-Hitting-the-Doors-in-NOVA
